selected_from_stage1.rule: minimum median TOTAL QR; tie smaller width

target_generation: Python random.Random(seed), shuffle 1..1023, exclude every recovered/prior Stage1 target visible locally, take first 12
equivalence_check: Run direct 21-QR word0 baseline on all 1024 candidates and verify every screen survivor with the same direct predicate; true key must be retained.
wall_time: secondary diagnostic only: warm both paths and report repeated local timing; admission is QR accounting plus exact survivor correctness, not Python interpreter timing
claim_limit: A PASS admits only a b=10 reduced-model constant-factor QR-count screening win. Candidate enumeration remains 2^b; alpha=1 leading exponent is unchanged; no full-round claim.
